biography.value:
Description

A type of elemental which emits a sickly green light as it floats through the air. They often lead travelers astray deep in the forest, bobbing tantalizingly like the lanterns held aloft by fellow pilgrims. Green wisps are drawn to the life energy of humans and their light can have a soothing, almost hypnotic effect that makes their prey more malleable. When a loved one gets lost in the woods, only to be found some time later in a weakened daze, you can rightly assume that a green wisp is most likely to blame.

Defense

AC 21, touch 21, flat-footed 13 (+2 deflect, +7 dex, +1 dodge, +1 size)

hp 28 [48] (8d6)

mp 25

Fort +1, Ref +13, Will +9

Defensive Abilities natural invisibility; Immune magic;

Weakness Ice

Offense

Speed fly 50 ft.(perfect)

Melee Shock +12 touch (2d6 wind damage)

Special Abilities Fiddle

Spells Known (FC CL 8th, Concentration +11)

At will (DC 13) - bleed, detect magic, mending, message, read magic

1st (DC 14) - aero

2nd (DC 15) - aero II, wind barrier

Statistics

Str 1, Dex 24, Con 10, Int 16, Wis 16, Cha 14

Base Atk +4; CMB -2; CMD 13

Feats Alertness, Dodge, Elemental Focus (Wind), Weapon Finesse

Skills Acrobatics +16, Bluff +8, Escape Artist +16, Fly +26, Perception +15, Stealth +20

Languages Aklo, Common

GM note: Printed MP 25; the full monster-caster chart plus the ability bonus determines this actor's 22 MP. Printed spell DC 14/15 is the base. Wind focus raises Aero to DC 15 and Aero II and Wind Barrier to DC 16. Fiddle's duration is not specified on this page.

description.value: Once every 1d6+1 rounds, the wisp's ability to create a surprisingly pleasant sound not unlike that of a tiny fiddle. The wisp creates a catchy tune that compels any creature within a 20-foot spread to dance and caper. A creature can resist this compulsion by making a successful Will save (DC 16). Creatures that fail are compelled to dance and shuffle their feet, and are effectively staggered for the duration of this spell. Once a creature makes the save against this spell, it is immune to further fiddle effects from that caster for 24 hours. This is a sonic mind-affecting effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 17).

save.description: Negates staggered dance; immune to this wisp for 24 hours

effect: Sonic mind-affecting compulsion; failures dance while the effect lasts. The page specifies no duration.
Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 17).
Recharge [[1d6+1]] rounds. Outside combat restore the charge after this interval.

description.value: Wisp are immune to all spells and spell-like abilities that allow spell resistance, except spells with the ice descriptor.

effect: Ignore spells and spell-like abilities that allow SR, except ice-descriptor spells. Ice weakness remains separate.

description.value: Wisp have the ability to extinguish their natural glow as a move action, effectively becoming invisible, as per the spell. If they get hit or attack in any form they become visible for 1d4 rounds.

effect: Extinguish the glow to become invisible. Attacking or being hit reveals the wisp for [[1d4]] rounds.

description.value: Toggle while invisible; suspend for 1d4 rounds after an attack or hit.
Transfer to failed-save targets; end when the tune ends.
